info.name: KisanSetu API — QA Contract Verification
info.description: Covers every route in server/routes/*.js. Each endpoint has a HAPPY PATH request and one deliberate BAD INPUT request to check the error shape against PROJECT_CONTRACT.md section 4 ({ "error": "message" } with 400/404/401). Run against a freshly seeded DB (npm run seed). Folders are named after the owning route file per contract section 4 ('existing route files own their resource').
